parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: "You are a Quality Reviewer. Review research for novelty, ethics, reproducibility."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content:
        "Review this research plan:\n" +
        "Topic: " + $json.topic + "\n" +
        "Literature: " + $json.artifacts.literatureReview + "\n" +
        "Strategy: " + $json.artifacts.gaps + "\n" +
        "Methodology: " + $json.artifacts.methodology + "\n" +
        "Implementation: " + $json.artifacts.datasetPlan + "\n" +
        "Experiments: " + $json.artifacts.results + "\n\n" +
        "Provide:\n" +
        "1. Novelty Score (1-10)\n" +
        "2. Ethical Concerns\n" +
        "3. Reproducibility Assessment\n" +
        "4. Limitations\n" +
        "5. Recommendations"
    }
  ],
  temperature: 0.3,
  max_tokens: 1500
}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  contents: [{
    parts: [{
      text:
        "You are an Academic Paper Compiler. Generate a complete IEEE-format research paper.

" +
        "Compile a complete research paper for: " + $json.topic + "

" +
        "Literature Review:
" + $json.artifacts.literatureReview + "

" +
        "Research Strategy:
" + $json.artifacts.gaps + "

" +
        "Methodology:
" + $json.artifacts.methodology + "

" +
        "Implementation:
" + $json.artifacts.datasetPlan + "

" +
        "Experiments:
" + $json.artifacts.results + "

" +
        "Quality Assessment:
" + $json.artifacts.analysis + "

" +
        "Generate complete paper with: Title, Abstract, Introduction, Literature Review, Methodology, Implementation, Results, Discussion, Conclusion, References."
    }]
  }],
  generationConfig: {
    temperature: 0.5,
    maxOutputTokens: 8000
  }
}) }}
